paragraphs: We are a clinical-stage biotechnology company focused on delivering innovative immunology therapeutics for autoimmune and inflammatory diseases. Our clinical-stage pipeline includes rosnilimab, a selective pathogenic T cell depleter, for which we completed a Phase 2b trial for the treatment of moderate-to-severe rheumatoid arthritis ("RA"), ANB033, a CD122 antagonist, in a Phase 1b trial for celiac disease ("CeD") and eosinophilic esophagitis ("EoE"), and ANB101, a BDCA2 modulator, in a Phase 1a trial. We also discovered and out-licensed, in financial collaborations, multiple therapeutic antibodies, including a PD-1 antagonist (Jemperli (dostarlimab-gxly) or "Jemperli") to GSK and an IL-36R antagonist (imsidolimab) to Vanda Pharmaceuticals Inc. ("Vanda"). We currently recognize revenue from milestones and royalties achieved under our immuno-oncology collaboration with GSK and license and transition services revenue from our collaboration with Vanda.

In September 2025, we announced that our board of directors ("Board of Directors") approved plans to explore separating our business into two independent, publicly traded companies. One company is expected to hold and continue to manage the financial collaboration for Jemperli from GSK and for imsidolimab from Vanda, with a focus on protecting and returning value of the royalties to its shareholders. The other company is expected to be a clinical-stage biotechnology company focused on the development and potential commercialization of innovative therapeutics for autoimmune and inflammatory diseases, including rosnilimab, ANB033 and ANB101. Upon completion of the proposed separation, which we expect to complete in the second quarter of 2026, we intend to launch the clinical-stage biotechnology company with adequate capital to fund operations for at least twelve months after the date the proposed separation is completed. While the proposed separation is anticipated to be a taxable event, we are focused on minimizing overall corporate and shareholder-level taxes across the entire transaction. Completion of the proposed separation is subject to final approval by our Board of Directors and other customary conditions, including the effectiveness of a registration statement with the Securities and Exchange Commission (the "SEC").

Our antibodies are in development to treat inflammatory diseases. We believe these molecules have potential applicability across a broad range of autoimmune and inflammatory diseases, including in gastroenterology, rheumatology, dermatology, respiratory, and other therapeutic areas.

Rosnilimab is an IgG1 antibody that directly targets pathogenic T cells, such as activated Tph/Tfh and T effector cells, in the periphery or inflamed tissue. These T cells, when activated, proliferate and migrate, and secrete the inflammatory cytokines that are the drivers of autoimmune and inflammatory diseases. Rosnilimab is designed to selectively deplete pathogenic T cells in both inflamed tissue and the periphery while sparing non-pathogenic T cells, including naïve T cells, to preserve overall immune function and restore immune homeostasis. This drives specific immunological outcomes, such as a reduction in T cell proliferation, migration and cytokine secretion, and a reduction of plasma cell generation and autoantibody levels. We announced top-line data from a healthy volunteer Phase 1 trial of rosnilimab in November 2021 that supported advancement of rosnilimab into subsequent patient trials. A total of 144 subjects were enrolled in the randomized, double-blind, placebo-controlled healthy volunteer Phase 1 trial, where single ascending dose ("SAD") cohorts received subcutaneous ("SC") or intravenous ("IV") single doses of rosnilimab up to 600mg or placebo, while multiple ascending dose ("MAD") cohorts received four weekly subcutaneous doses of rosnilimab ranging up to 400mg or placebo. Rosnilimab was generally well-tolerated and no dose-limiting toxicities were observed. Rosnilimab demonstrated a sustained systemic exposure and dose-proportionality with an estimated two-week half-life for subcutaneous and IV routes of administration.

In February 2025, we announced initial data, which was subsequently updated in June 2025, from rosnilimab's randomized, placebo-controlled, global 424-patient, Phase 2b clinical trial for moderate-to-severe rheumatoid arthritis. Patients were randomized to receive either 100mg of subcutaneous rosnilimab every four weeks (Q4W), 400mg Q4W, 600mg every two weeks, or placebo.

During the three-month placebo-controlled period, the trial achieved its primary endpoint by observing the reduction of disease activity using the disease activity score, 28 joints (DAS-28) C-Reactive Protein ("CRP") score, as well as ACR20 response (an accepted Phase 3 registrational endpoint), at Week 12 in all three doses of rosnilimab compared to placebo. Rosnilimab achieved its secondary endpoint by demonstrating statistical significance in at least one dose and numerical superiority at all doses, including once monthly administration, on ACR20, ACR50 and with respect to the clinical disease activity index ("CDAI") low disease activity ("LDA") score at Week 12. Specifically, at Week 12, ACR20 achieved statistical significance at 100 mg (p < 0.05), 400 mg (p < 0.01), and 600 mg (p < 0.001); ACR50 achieved statistical significance at 600 mg (p < 0.05); and CDAI LDA achieved statistical significance at 100 mg (p < 0.05) and 400 mg (p < 0.01).

Following completion of the Week 14 visit, 69% (or 220 of the 318) rosnilimab-treated patients who achieved CDAI LDA at this timepoint continued their assigned treatment through six months in a blinded, all-active treatment period. At six months, rosnilimab results demonstrated deepening of responses through six months on CDAI LDA, CDAI remission and ACR70 and independent of prior treatments, including anti-TNFα, anti-IL6R or JAK inhibitors. Importantly, this was particularly observed in b/tsDMARD-experienced patients for the 400mg Q4W and 600mg Q2W doses, showing a dose response relative to the 100mg Q4W dose. Furthermore, Week 28 clinical responses across multiple measures, including CDAI LDA, mean CDAI, mean DAS28-CRP and ACR50/70, were durable off-drug through at least three months after the last rosnilimab dose, results which we believe suggest the potential for extended dosing (e.g., Q8W/Q12W) after initial monthly dosing. Due to the trial design, max response rates for rosnilimab have not yet been observed as strict criteria at Week 14, which prevented additional patients with meaningful improvement from continuing treatment in the trial.

Even if our product candidates receive regulatory approval, they will be subject to significant post-marketing regulatory requirements.
We may not be successful in our efforts to expand our pipeline of product candidates and develop marketable products.

We face significant competition, and if our competitors develop and market products that are more effective, safer or less expensive than our product candidates, our commercial opportunities will be negatively impacted.
Our product candidates may not achieve adequate market acceptance among physicians, patients, health care payors and others in the medical community necessary for commercial success.

Some of our suppliers may experience disruption to their respective supply chain due to the effects of macroeconomic conditions, which could delay, prevent or impair our development or commercialization efforts.

paragraphs: Investing in our common stock involves a high degree of risk. You should carefully consider the risks described below, as well as the other information in this report, including our consolidated financial statements and the related notes and "Management's Discussion and Analysis of Financial Condition and Results of Operations," before deciding whether to invest in our common stock. The occurrence of any of the events or developments described below could harm our business, financial condition, results of operations, and growth prospects. In such an event, the market price of our common stock could decline, and you may lose all or part of your investment.

An investment in our common stock involves various risks, and prospective investors are urged to carefully consider the matters discussed in the section titled "Risk Factors" prior to making an investment in our common stock. These risks include, but are not limited to, the following:

• Our product candidates in development may fail or suffer delays that adversely affect their commercial viability. Results from our initial clinical trials may not be representative of the results we will experience in later clinical trials. If we or our collaborators are unable to complete development of or commercialize our product candidates or experience significant delays in doing so, our business will be materially harmed.

• Our ongoing and planned clinical trials or those of our collaborators may reveal significant adverse events, toxicities or other side effects and may result in a safety profile that could inhibit regulatory approval or market acceptance of any of our product candidates.

• We and/or our collaborators may be unable to obtain, or may be delayed in obtaining, required regulatory approvals in the United States or in foreign jurisdictions, which would materially impair our ability to commercialize and generate revenue from our product candidates.
• Even if our product candidates receive regulatory approval, they will be subject to significant post-marketing regulatory requirements.

paragraphs: 本公司為一家臨牀階段生物科技公司，專注於開發創新免疫學治療藥物，用以治療自身免疫及發炎性疾病。本公司臨牀階段的產品線包括rosnilimab，一種選擇性病原T細胞清除劑，我們已完成針對中度至重度類風濕性關節炎（"RA"）治療的第二期b試驗，ANB033，一種CD122拮抗劑，正在進行針對乳糜瀉（"CeD"）及嗜酸性食道炎（"EoE"）的第二期b試驗，以及ANB101，一種BDCA2調節劑，正在進行第一期a試驗。本公司亦在財務合作中發現並授權多種治療性單株抗體，包括PD-1拮抗劑（Jemperli（dostarlimab-gxly）或"Jemperli"）至葛蘭素史克（"GSK"），以及IL-36R拮抗劑（imsidolimab）至Vanda Pharmaceuticals Inc.（"Vanda"）。本公司目前從與GSK的免疫腫瘤學合作中取得里程碑及版稅收入，並從與Vanda的合作中取得授權及過渡服務收入。

2025年9月，本公司宣佈，董事會（"董事會"）批准計畫，探討將本公司業務分為兩家獨立、公開上市的公司。其中一家公司預期將持有並繼續管理來自GSK的Jemperli及來自Vanda的imsidolimab的財務合作，專注於保護並回饋股東的版稅價值。另一家公司預期為一家臨牀階段生物科技公司，專注於開發及潛在商業化創新治療藥物，用以治療自身免疫及發炎性疾病，包括rosnilimab、ANB033及ANB101。預計在2026年第二季完成建議的分離後，本公司意圖發起這家臨牀階段生物科技公司，並擁有足夠資金以支應分離完成後至少十二個月的營運。雖然建議的分離預期為課稅事件，但本公司專注於整體公司及股東層面的稅務最小化。建議的分離完成需經董事會最終批准及其他慣例條件，包括與證券交易委員會（"SEC"）的註冊聲明生效。
本公司開發的單株抗體用以治療發炎性疾病。本公司相信這些分子在廣泛的自身免疫及發炎性疾病中具有潛在應用，包括在消化系統、風濕免疫、皮膚科、呼吸系統及其他治療領域。

Rosnilimab為一種IgG1單株抗體，直接針對病原T細胞，例如活化的Tph/Tfh及T效應細胞，在周邊或發炎組織中。這些T細胞在活化後會增殖並遷移，並分泌發炎性細胞激素，這些細胞激素是自身免疫及發炎性疾病的主要驅動因素。Rosnilimab設計為選擇性清除病原T細胞，同時保留非病原T細胞，包括未活化的T細胞，以維持整體免疫功能並恢復免疫平衡。這會導致特定的免疫學結果，例如減少T細胞增殖、遷移及細胞激素分泌，以及減少血漿細胞生成及自身抗體水平。本公司於2021年11月宣佈來自健康志願者第一期試驗的初步數據，支持rosnilimab進入後續患者試驗。總共有144名受試者參與隨機、雙盲、安慰劑對照的健康志願者第一期試驗，其中單劑遞增（"SAD"）組別接受皮下（"SC"）或靜脈（"IV"）單劑rosnilimab，劑量最高達600mg或安慰劑，而多劑遞增（"MAD"）組別接受四週一次皮下rosnilimab，劑量最高達400mg或安慰劑。Rosnilimab通常耐受良好，未觀察到劑量限制性毒性。Rosnilimab顯示出持續的全身暴露及劑量比例性，估計皮下及靜脈給藥途徑的半衰期為兩週。
2025年2月，本公司宣佈來自rosnilimab的隨機、安慰劑對照、全球424名患者、第二期b臨牀試驗的初步數據，該試驗針對中度至重度類風濕性關節炎。患者被隨機分配接受每四週皮下注射100mg rosnilimab、400mg每四週、600mg每兩週，或安慰劑。

在三月份的安慰劑對照期中，試驗達成其主要終點，觀察到使用疾病活動指數，28關節（DAS-28）C反應蛋白（"CRP"）分數，以及ACR20反應（被接受的第三期註冊終點），在所有三種rosnilimab劑量於第12週相比安慰劑時，疾病活動減少。Rosnilimab達成其次要終點，顯示在至少一種劑量上具有統計顯著性，並在所有劑量上顯示出數值優勢，包括每月一次給藥，在第12週的ACR20、ACR50及臨牀疾病活動指數（"CDAI"）低疾病活動（"LDA"）分數上。具體而言，在第12週，ACR20在100mg（p < 0.05）、400mg（p < 0.01）及600mg（p < 0.001）時達統計顯著性；ACR50在600mg（p < 0.05）時達統計顯著性；CDAI LDA在100mg（p < 0.05）及400mg（p < 0.01）時達統計顯著性。

完成第14週訪問後，69%（或318名受試者中的220名）在該時間點達成CDAI LDA的rosnilimab治療患者繼續接受指定治療，持續六個月的盲測、所有活性治療期。在六個月時，rosnilimab的結果顯示在CDAI LDA、CDAI緩解及ACR70上持續反應，且與先前治療無關，包括抗TNFα、抗IL6R或JAK抑制劑。重要的是，這在400mg每四週及600mg每兩週劑量的b/tsDMARD經驗患者中特別觀察到，顯示出與100mg每四週劑量相比的劑量反應。此外，在多個指標上，包括CDAI LDA、平均CDAI、平均DAS28-CRP及ACR50/70，第28週的臨牀反應在最後一次rosnilimab給藥後至少三個月內持續，結果顯示本公司認為這顯示出延長給藥（例如每八週或每十二週）的潛力。由於試驗設計，rosnilimab的最大反應率尚未在第14週觀察到，這阻止了更多有顯著改善的患者繼續參與試驗。

paragraphs: 您應閱讀下列對我們財務狀況及營運成果之討論與分析，並與本年度10-K申報表第二部分第8項「合併財務報表及補充資料」所附之歷史合併財務報表及其附註一併參考。本討論及其他本年度10-K申報表之內容包含前瞻性陳述，涉及風險與不確定性，例如我們的計畫、目標、期望、意圖與信念。我們實際結果可能與這些前瞻性陳述所討論之內容有重大差異。導致這種差異的因素包括，但不僅限於，下列所識別的風險因素，以及本年度10-K申報表第一部分第1A項「風險因素」段落中所討論的風險因素。您也應謹慎閱讀「關於前瞻性陳述之特別說明」。

我們是一家臨牀階段的生物科技公司，專注於開發創新免疫學治療藥物，用以治療自身免疫及發炎性疾病。我們的臨牀階段產品線包括rosnilimab，一種選擇性病原性T細胞清除劑，我們已完成針對中度至重度類風濕性關節炎（"RA"）治療的第二期b臨牀試驗，ANB033，一種CD122拮抗劑，正在進行針對乳糜瀉（"CeD"）及嗜酸性食道炎（"EoE"）的第二期b臨牀試驗，以及ANB101，一種BDCA2調節劑，正在進行第一期a臨牀試驗。我們也發現並在財務合作中授權發行多種治療性單株抗體，包括PD-1拮抗劑（Jemperli（dostarlimab-gxly）或"Jemperli"）給葛蘭素史克（"GSK"），以及IL-36R拮抗劑（imsidolimab）給Vanda Pharmaceuticals Inc.（"Vanda"）。我們目前從與GSK的免疫腫瘤學合作中達成的里程碑及版稅認列收入，以及從與Vanda的合作中認列的授權及過渡服務收入。

2025年9月，我們宣佈董事會（"董事會"）批准計畫，探討將我們的業務分為兩家獨立、公開上市的公司。其中一家公司預期將持有並繼續管理來自GSK的Jemperli財務合作以及來自Vanda的imsidolimab財務合作，專注於保護並回饋這些版稅給股東。另一家公司預期將成為一家臨牀階段的生物科技公司，專注於開發及潛在商業化創新治療藥物，用以治療自身免疫及發炎性疾病，包括rosnilimab、ANB033及ANB101。預計在2026年第二季完成此分離計畫後，我們將發起這家臨牀階段的生物科技公司，並以足夠的資金支持其至少十二個月的運作。雖然此分離計畫預期為課稅事件，但我們專注於整個交易中企業及股東層面的稅務最小化。完成此分離計畫需經董事會最終批准及其他慣例條件，包括與證券交易委員會（"SEC"）的註冊申報書生效。
我們的單株抗體正在開發中，用以治療發炎性疾病。我們相信這些分子在廣泛的自身免疫及發炎性疾病中具有潛在應用，包括在消化系統、風濕免疫、皮膚科、呼吸系統及其他治療領域。

Rosnilimab是一種IgG1單株抗體，直接針對病原性T細胞，例如活化的Tph/Tfh及T效應細胞，在外周或發炎組織中。這些T細胞在活化後會增殖並遷移，並分泌發炎性細胞激素，這些細胞激素是自身免疫及發炎性疾病的主要驅動因素。Rosnilimab設計為選擇性清除病原性T細胞，同時保留非病原性T細胞，包括未活化的T細胞，以維持整體免疫功能並恢復免疫平衡。這會引導特定的免疫學結果，例如減少T細胞增殖、遷移及細胞激素分泌，以及減少血漿細胞生成及自身抗體水平。我們在2021年11月宣佈了rosnilimab在健康志願者中的第一期臨牀試驗的初步數據，支持rosnilimab進入後續患者試驗。總共有144名受試者參與了隨機、雙盲、安慰劑對照的健康志願者第一期臨牀試驗，其中單劑量遞增（"SAD"）組別接受皮下（"SC"）或靜脈（"IV"）單劑量rosnilimab，最高達600mg或安慰劑，而多劑量遞增（"MAD"）組別接受四週一次皮下劑量rosnilimab，最高達400mg或安慰劑。Rosnilimab通常耐受良好，未觀察到劑量限制性毒性。Rosnilimab顯示出持續的全身暴露及劑量比例性，估計皮下及靜脈給藥途徑的半衰期為兩週。
2025年2月，我們宣佈了rosnilimab在中度至重度類風濕性關節炎的隨機、安慰劑對照、全球424名受試者第二期b臨牀試驗的初步數據，此後於2025年6月更新。受試者被隨機分為接受每四週皮下注射100mg rosnilimab、400mg rosnilimab、每兩週600mg rosnilimab，或安慰劑。

在三個月的安慰劑對照期中，試驗達成其主要終點，觀察到使用疾病活動指數，28關節（DAS-28）C反應蛋白（"CRP"）分數，以及ACR20反應（被接受的第三期註冊終點），在所有三種rosnilimab劑量於第12週相比安慰劑有顯著減少。Rosnilimab在次要終點上表現出統計顯著性在至少一種劑量，並在所有劑量上顯示出數值優勢，包括每月一次給藥，於ACR20、ACR50及臨牀疾病活動指數（"CDAI"）低疾病活動（"LDA"）分數在第12週。具體而言，在第12週，ACR20在100 mg（p < 0.05）、400 mg（p < 0.01）和600 mg（p < 0.001）劑量時達到統計顯著性；ACR50在600 mg（p < 0.05）劑量時達到統計顯著性；而CDAI LDA在100 mg（p < 0.05）和400 mg（p < 0.01）劑量時達到統計顯著性。

完成第14週訪問後，69%（或318名受試者中的220名）在該時間點達到CDAI LDA的rosnilimab治療受試者繼續接受其指定治療，持續六個月的盲測、所有活性治療期。在六個月時，rosnilimab的結果顯示在CDAI LDA、CDAI緩解及ACR70上持續反應，且與先前治療無關，包括抗TNFα、抗IL6R或JAK抑制劑。重要的是，這在400mg Q4W及600mg Q2W劑量的b/tsDMARD經驗患者中特別觀察到，顯示與100mg Q4W劑量相比的劑量反應。此外，在多個指標上，包括CDAI LDA、平均CDAI、平均DAS28-CRP及ACR50/70，於最後rosnilimab劑量後至少三個月的無藥物期間，臨牀反應持續，我們認為這顯示rosnilimab可能具有延長給藥（例如Q8W/Q12W）的潛力。由於試驗設計，rosnilimab的最大反應率尚未在第14週觀察到嚴格的標準，這阻止了更多有顯著改善的受試者繼續參與試驗。

headings: 與我們產品候選藥物之發現及開發相關之風險
即使我們之產品候選藥物獲得監管機構核准，仍將面臨重大之上市後監管要求。
我們可能無法成功拓展產品候選藥物之管線並開發具市場價值之產品。
我們面臨重大競爭，若競爭對手開發並行銷之產品較我們之產品候選藥物更具功效、更安全或成本更低，將對我們之商業機會造成負面影響。
我們之產品候選藥物可能無法在醫師、病患、醫療給付者及其他醫療界人士中獲得足夠之市場接受度，此為實現商業成功所必需。
部分我們之供應商可能因總體經濟條件之影響而使其供應鏈出現中斷，此可能延宕、阻礙或影響我們之產品開發或商業化努力。
總體經濟與地緣政治環境可能對美國與全球經濟產生重大影響，並可能對我們之業務、財務狀況及營運成果產生重大影響。

paragraphs: 投資本公司普通股涉及高度風險。您應仔細考慮下列所描述的風險，以及本報告中其他資訊，包括我們的合併財務報表及相關附註與「管理層對財務狀況與營運成果之討論與分析」，再決定是否投資本公司普通股。上述任何事件或發展若發生，將可能對本公司業務、財務狀況、營運成果與成長前景造成損害。在此情況下，本公司普通股的市場價格可能下跌，您可能損失全部或部分投資。
投資本公司普通股涉及多種風險，預期投資人應在投資本公司普通股前，謹慎考慮「風險因素」節中所討論的各項事項。這些風險包括但不限於以下內容：
• 我們正在開發的產品候選藥物可能失敗或遭遇延誤，而對其商業可行性造成不利影響。我們初步臨牀試驗的結果可能無法代表我們在後續臨牀試驗中所經驗到的結果。若我們或我們的合作夥伴無法完成產品候選藥物的開發或商業化，或遭遇重大延誤，將對本公司業務造成重大損害。
• 我們持續進行或計畫進行的臨牀試驗或我們合作夥伴的臨牀試驗，可能揭露重大不良事件、毒性或其它副作用，並可能導致產品候選藥物的安全性評估不利於取得監管機關批准或市場接受度。
• 我們與/或我們的合作夥伴可能無法取得，或延誤取得，美國或外國監管機關所要求的核准，這將嚴重影響我們商業化產品候選藥物並產生收入的能力。
• 即使我們的產品候選藥物取得監管核准，仍將面臨重大上市後監管要求。
